expected_verdict_schema.failure_reason: null on success; otherwise the FailureReason wire object, tag key `type`
expected_verdict_schema.note: optional — prose for verdicts that are not the obvious guess from the category name
expected_verdict_schema.policy: optional — VerifierPolicy pins REQUIRED to reach this verdict; absent means defaults
expected_verdict_schema.status: the verdict: verified (valid at stage 8, which needs a trust-chain manifest the corpus does not pin), not_anchored (valid at stage 7) or not_verified
expected_verdict_schema.valid: bool — the chain and signature hold under the key used; not a verdict on its own (true at stage 7, where the key is the one the proof carries)
